name: komdosh-dev-spring-security
description: Defensive security audits for Kotlin + Spring WebFlux services. Spring-specific only — no generic CVE/secret-scan wrappers (those are commodity tooling). /security-audit (composite sweep) · /auth-audit (route ↔ SecurityWebFilterChain coverage matrix — flags unauthenticated @RestController handlers) · /error-leakage-check (RFC 9457 responses must not include stack traces, SQL, or internal IDs in any non-prod profile + verify @ExceptionHandler maps unhandled Exception to 500 with correlation id only) · /jwt-rotation (JWK source freshness + rotation cadence + algorithm allowlist). Ships security-auditor agent, three skills, rules/security-audit.md. Read-only — never modifies code; produces docs/security/<topic>.md reports with findings classified BLOCKER / WARNING / INFO. Distinct from core's security-expert agent which WRITES auth filters; this AUDITS what's already there. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
